cost_comparison: 60%+ reduction compared with the previous EBS io2 setup; not a guarantee for Postgres customers.

image.caption: Hourly cost of the database when Metal went live
image.handling: Original higher-resolution upload preserved. CSS inversion, hue rotation, and screen blending adapt the presentation to the dark slide; bar geometry is unchanged. No numeric axes, series names, or exact latency changes inferred.

claims.pressure: Disk I/O saturation degraded Inbox performance at peak load.
claims.workaround: Overscaling and upgrading to high-IOPS EBS io2 volumes; new replicas took hours to provision and catch up.
claims.metal: Locally attached NVMe replaces network-attached EBS storage.
claims.outcomes: Improved tail latency and 60%+ lower cost compared with prior EBS io2 volumes.

diagram.handling: Native vector illustration of the published bottleneck and workaround. Replica stack and queued request blocks are schematic, not measured counts or a complete deployment topology. The workaround added headroom at higher cost; no invented latency or cost values. Two click reveals lead to the unchanged published cost chart.

logo.handling: Official header SVG mark; geometry preserved, scaled proportionally, displayed in white with CSS inversion.
